title: Combinatorial approximations of dynamical systems: a separated graph approach
summary: Separated graphs provide a powerful combinatorial tool for approximating dynamical systems. This paper details the explicit construction of Bratteli-like separated graphs -- a generalization of classical Bratteli diagrams -- that encode the dynamics of a homeomorphism $h$ on a totally disconnected, compact metric space $X$. Unlike standard approaches, the separated graph framework allows us to explicitly disentangle the static structure of the space from the dynamics of the homeomorphism.
